title: Haare ka Sahara Baba Shyam
style: 3D animated devotional movie style, Pixar quality, soft cinematic lighting, rich warm colours, no text, no letters, no writing

scenes.prompt: Divine darshan of Khatu Shyam Baba, serene face with large calm eyes, dark curly hair, golden crown with a peacock feather, red tilak, garlands of fresh red roses, glowing diya light behind him, devotional temple sanctum
scenes.tts: कौन है हारे का सहारा? बाबा श्याम।
scenes.sub: Kaun hai haare ka sahara? Baba Shyam.

scenes.prompt: Young warrior Barbarik kneeling before Lord Krishna in a quiet moonlit battlefield, Krishna smiling with raised hand in blessing, soft golden glow around them, emotional and respectful
scenes.tts: कृष्ण बोले, कलियुग में तुम श्याम नाम से पूजे जाओगे।
scenes.sub: Krishna bole, Kaliyug mein tum Shyam naam se pooje jaoge.

scenes.prompt: Devotees with folded hands and flags walking towards the glowing Khatu Shyam temple at dusk, lamps lit along the path, fresh flower garlands, peaceful golden sky, joyful devotional mood
scenes.tts: आज भी भक्त श्रद्धा से खाटू धाम में शीश नवाते हैं।
scenes.sub: Aaj bhi bhakt shraddha se Khatu Dham mein sheesh navaate hain.

scenes.tts: हारे का सहारा, बाबा श्याम हमारा! लाइक, शेयर और सब्सक्राइब करें।
scenes.sub: Haare ka sahara, Baba Shyam hamara! Darshan achhe lagein to Like, Share aur Subscribe karein · Shyam Premi SN
